evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/v/a$a is an enum whose three surviving constants are LEFT, RIGHT and NORMAL.
R66 Signlink compares this enum immediately after obtaining Java Sound FloatControl.Type.PAN; RIGHT sets +1.0f, LEFT sets -1.0f, and NORMAL leaves the neutral value unchanged.
The enum has no unrelated exact-v308 consumer; its observed use is the stereo pan control in Signlink audio playback.

proposals.note: AudioPan is descriptive exact-behavior recovery fixed by preserved LEFT/RIGHT/NORMAL constants and FloatControl.Type.PAN consumption.
